key_points: Main arm scored 55.4535 (predicted 45–60), confirming that strip construction + 2-opt + prime-city placement at every-10th step meaningfully beats the x-sorted baseline across all 20 test cases.
Negative control scored exactly 0, confirming the identity tour equals the checker's baseline — the scoring differential is real and attributable to the optimization.

Multiple alternative improvements were explored within this iteration (ILS/double-bridge perturbation, or-opt moves, edge caching, wider 2-opt windows) but none surpassed the 55.45 score, suggesting the current approach is near a local optimum for the ~2.5s time budget.

Significant room for improvement remains (score is 55/100). Next iteration should investigate fundamentally different strategies: nearest-neighbor or greedy edge-insertion construction, 3-opt or Lin-Kernighan moves, or simulated annealing to escape the 2-opt local optimum basin.
